title: 第22章 狼崖山第23章 得到果树
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
“爷爷，我来这里还有一个原因是，我有一个很重要的东西在另一个县，但是可能去拿有点危险。
今天我们去的那个地方是我姑姑家，去姑姑家之前，我必须得去把那东西取了。
所以我如果二十天没有回来，您就拿着这封信去梧桐巷16号，我姑姑定会好好照顾你的。”
“鹤清，你要去的地方那么危险，把我带上吧，我一把老骨头，也没什么好可惜的，去了还能给你挡一挡。”
“齐爷爷，您说什么呢？我肯定会安全回来的，您就在这里等我回来。
后面那辆马车上有我们的所有东西，还有这张银票，您先帮我保管着。”
“什么保管，我不保管，你不是小孩子了，你自己管。”齐爷爷不收银票。
“唉，我长这么大，也没有什么可信任的人，难道这银票要便宜了别人吗？”林鹤清也不收。
“好好好，我帮你拿着，你一定要及时回来啊，听见没有。”
“我知道了，房间我订了一个月，您就在这安心住着。”
“嗯，一切小心。”
“我知道。”
第二天，林鹤清就独自驾着马车离开，他已经知道斜阳县的方向，去那里就两天的路程。
到了斜阳县，林鹤清下马车到一个客栈停下，他开了一个房间，住一晚。
然后晚上的时候，林鹤清下楼叫小二一会送一桌子饭菜上来。
等小二上来送上来的时候，林鹤清给了小二一角银子，小二拿到手开心极了。
“谢谢客官，您是不是有什么想问的？”
“我是岭阳县的，来斜阳县找亲戚，他给我写信说住在狼崖山脚，我想问问你，狼崖山上哪个方向？”
“狼崖山呀，我们都知道，那山上有狼呢，常听见晚上有狼嚎，吓人的很。”小二能说会道，嘴皮子溜得很。
“狼崖山就从这南门出去，往右走，那条路一直往前，遇到岔路就走右边，一直走到尽头就是了。”

小二拿了报酬，路倒是指的挺清楚的，也完全没有防备，毕竟狼崖山太偏了，偶尔有别的地方的亲戚来，都是找不到在哪的。
要小二来说，这些几年十几年不联系的亲戚，突然来找，不是有喜事就是来报丧呢，可不敢耽误。
“好，我知道了，辛苦了。”
林鹤清再拿了一角银子给小二，让他走了。
第二天，林鹤清就驾着马车离开了，一路向右，第三天下午就到了狼崖山脚下的李家村。
林鹤清一进入李家村，村口的大爷就问林鹤清来这里是找什么人。
因为李家村已经是这条路最后一个村子了，到了这里，只能是找李家村的人。
林鹤清早就找好了理由，说自己听说狼崖山有人参，是来狼崖山找人参的。
问狼崖山有没有村民见过山上有人参，他祖母需要一根人参续命。
林鹤清年轻的面容使得他说的话可信度不高，村民一致认为林鹤清是被别人骗了。
content_en:
“Grandpa, another reason why I came here is that I have something very important in another county, but it might be a bit dangerous to get it.
The place we went to today was my aunt's house. Before going to my aunt's house, I had to pick up that thing.
So if I don't come back in twenty days, take this letter and go to No. 16 Wutong Lane. My aunt will definitely take good care of you. "
"He Qing, the place you are going to is so dangerous, take me with you. I am an old man, so there is nothing to regret. I can still block you."
"Grandpa Qi, what are you talking about? I will definitely come back safely. Just wait here for me to come back.
The carriage behind contains all our things, as well as this bank note. Please keep it safe for me. "
"What about safekeeping? I won't keep it. You are not a child anymore. You can take care of it yourself." Grandpa Qi did not accept the cashier's check.
"Hey, I've grown up and I don't have anyone I can trust. Is this bank note going to be cheaper for others?" Lin Heqing didn't accept it either.
"Okay, okay, I'll hold it for you. You must come back in time, do you hear me?"
"I understand. I have reserved the room for a month, and you can live here with peace of mind."
"Well, be careful."
"I know."
The next day, Lin Heqing drove the carriage alone and left. He already knew the direction of Xieyang County, and it was only two days' journey there.
When he arrived in Xieyang County, Lin Heqing got off the carriage and stopped at an inn. He booked a room and stayed for one night.
Then at night, Lin Heqing went downstairs and asked the waiter to bring a table of food.
When the waiter came up to deliver it, Lin Heqing gave the waiter a dime of silver. The waiter was very happy to get it.
"Thank you sir, do you have anything to ask?"
"I'm from Lingyang County. I came to Xieyang County to find relatives. He wrote to me and said he lived at the foot of Langya Mountain. I want to ask you, which direction is Langya Mountain?"
"Langya Mountain, we all know that there are wolves on that mountain. We often hear wolves howling at night, which is very scary." The waiter is a eloquent and smooth talker.
"Go out of the south gate of Langya Mountain and go right. The road goes straight forward. If you encounter a fork in the road, go right and go to the end."
The waiter got paid, and the directions were quite clear, and he was completely unprepared. After all, Langya Mountain was too remote. Occasionally, relatives from other places came, but they couldn't be found.
As for the waiter, these relatives who have not been in contact for more than ten years suddenly come to visit, either to celebrate a happy event or to report a funeral, so they don't dare to delay.
"Okay, I understand, thank you for your hard work."
Lin Heqing gave the waiter another dime and let him go.
The next day, Lin Heqing drove away in a carriage, all the way to the right, and arrived at Lijia Village at the foot of Langya Mountain on the afternoon of the third day.
As soon as Lin Heqing entered Lijia Village, the uncle at the entrance of the village asked Lin Heqing who he was looking for here.
Because Lijiacun is already the last village on this road, when you get here, you can only look for people from Lijiacun.
Lin He had already found a reason early in the morning, saying that he had heard that there were ginseng in Langya Mountain and came to Langya Mountain to look for ginseng.
Asked whether any villagers in Langya Mountain had seen ginseng on the mountain. His grandmother needed a ginseng stick to survive.
Lin Heqing's young face made what he said less credible, and the villagers unanimously believed that Lin Heqing had been deceived.
